evidence.title: Indosat's Infra Fiber Teknologi spin-off launches AI-ready RAIA Grid

summary: Indosat's newly independent infrastructure arm, Infra Fiber Teknologi, has introduced RAIA Grid, a network designed to support AI workloads. The platform aims to enhance connectivity and computational capacity for AI applications in the region.
title: Indosat Spin-Off Infra Fiber Teknologi Launches AI-Ready RAIA Grid
